author: Pallas, 1773
status: 나그네새 10만 마리 이상 · 겨울철새 수백 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
summary: 그리 흔하지 않은 나그네새 또는 겨울철새이다. 아고산대와 고산대 숲에서 번식하며, 바위나 언덕 벼랑의 굴, 큰 나무뿌리나 쓰러진 나무 밑에 부드러운 식물 줄기로 오목한 둥지를 짓는다. 알은 흰 바탕에 엷은 적갈색 반점이 있고 보통 3~6개를 낳는다. 아시아 동부와 중부에 분포하고 주로 대만 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

sexes.male: 머리와 등, 꼬리가 짙은 청색이고 배는 희며 옆구리는 황갈색이다.
sexes.female: 등은 옅은 황갈색이고 허리와 꼬리는 청색을 띠며, 배는 희고 옆구리는 주황색을 띤다.

art.subject: Red-flanked Bluetail (Tarsiger cyanurus), adult male in fresh plumage, as seen in Korean forest on autumn migration (October): crown, nape, ear-coverts, back, wings and tail rich cobalt blue, with brighter blue on the shoulder; a short, narrow white supercilium from the forehead to above the eye; chin and throat white, bordered by the blue sides of the neck and breast; centre of the breast greyish-white; flanks bright orange; belly and undertail coverts white. Thin black bill; large dark eye; dark grey legs.
art.pose: perched low on a mossy log in the forest, side view
art.scene: Korean autumn forest understorey with mossy fallen logs; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched on a low branch: cobalt-blue head, back and tail, short white supercilium reaching the forehead, white throat bordered blue, white belly, bright orange flanks

adult female (first-year males look the same), side view perched: olive-brown upperparts, blue rump and tail, narrow whitish eye-ring, white throat bordered by olive-brown breast sides, white belly, orange flanks
art.build: Small, robin-like chat, 14cm, about the size of a sparrow but rounder-headed and larger-eyed, with an upright stance on low perches and the forest floor. Bill thin, short and straight, much shorter than the head. Legs slender, medium length, dark grey. At rest the wingtips reach just past the base of the tail. Tail medium length, square-ended, frequently flicked downward and slightly spread.
avoid: Do not paint orange on the breast or throat; the orange is confined to the flanks.
Do not paint a blue back on the female; only her rump and tail are blue.
Do not give it white wing bars or white in the tail.
Do not paint pinkish legs or white underparts without orange flanks — that is Siberian Blue Robin (Larvivora cyane).
